description: Defines the Document entity class for persisting document metadata in the database, including filename, content type, size, storage path, and association with a Project.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Entity class representing a document with metadata and a link to a project.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the document.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the document.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the document.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the document.

methods.name: getSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the document in bytes.

methods.name: setSizeBytes
methods.description: Sets the size of the document in bytes.

methods.name: getStoragePath
methods.description: Returns the storage path of the document.

methods.name: setStoragePath
methods.description: Sets the storage path of the document.
